SUMMARY OF TERMS (SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, FOUNDER-FRIENDLY VERSION)

Invented for testing seed-terms. Leashly, Inc. and Kite Hill Capital are fictional. Not a real offer.

Liquidation Preference: 1x non-participating. In a sale, holders of Series Seed receive the greater of the Original Purchase Price or what they would receive on conversion to Common Stock.

Dividends: Non-cumulative dividends only when, as and if declared by the Board.

Anti-dilution: Broad-based weighted average.

Redemption: None. The Series Seed is not redeemable.

Board of Directors: Three directors: two designated by the holders of Common Stock and one designated by the holders of Series Seed.

Protective Provisions: The consent of the holders of a majority of the Series Seed is required to (i) change the rights of the Series Seed, (ii) create a senior security, or (iii) sell the Company.

No-Shop: 30 days.

Pro Rata Rights: Major Investors may purchase their pro rata share of the next financing.

Founder Vesting: Founder shares that have vested stay vested; unvested shares continue on their existing schedule, with double-trigger acceleration.

Option Pool: 10% of the post-money fully diluted capitalization.

Expiration: This term sheet expires if not signed within fourteen (14) days.
